db_fingerprint_role: db_sha256 and db_bytes are historical hydrated observations, not a cross-import byte gate; identity is the immutable archive plus a fresh pinned-tool controlled import
transport: resolve the official schema-v6 publisher once per scan and preserve its response; require active status, exact schema, a timestamped basename, SHA256 and a build within seven days; pin that immutable archive for the complete run, verify its bytes before a fresh controlled import, force Grype checksum validation and exact schema/built/path/manual-import status, and reject subsequent change; the stored url/checksums remain historical observations, never a stale fallback
